name: Recording studio

pf.license.need: none checked by Rosie: a recording studio needs no state license in most places; the business registration is the owner's own word; a studio's insurance is optional for the booking
pf.license.who: the studio for its own registration, if it has one; each engineer for any certificate they choose to show
pf.license.ask: optional: the registration number the owner wants shown; nothing is checked
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never checks a license, certificate, insurance or permit (D96); the studio keeps its own records
pf.license.blocks: nothing: no license or certificate blocks a booking here
pf.license.renewals: a reminder the owner sets for its own dates, if it wants one
pf.license.insurance: liability and gear insurance is the studio's own matter; optional for the booking
pf.license.background: any background check for staff is the owner's own step, outside Rosie

pf.services.shape: a room and an engineer for a block of hours (tracking, mixing, mastering); an album block booked as several sessions; location recording at a home or venue with a mobile rig (flow B)
pf.services.examples: the example studio's own prices (Lee Sound Studio and Lee Mobile Sound), not a standard

list.name: 3-hour tracking session
list.note: a band of up to 4 players in the main room (example); extra players are a separate booking

list.name: 1-hour mixing session
list.where: at the studio, or by a shared file link
list.before: a card saved for the $40 no-show fee
list.after: paid at the front desk after

list.name: 1-hour mastering session
list.where: at the studio, or by a shared file link
list.before: a card saved for the $40 fee
list.after: the saved card is charged at DONE, when the final files are sent

list.name: Album block (10 hours)
list.after: the $800 rest paid at the studio at the last session
list.capacity: booked as sessions; a session that runs over is a new booking with the artist's yes

list.name: Location recording (3 hours, flow B)
list.length: 3 hours with an engineer and a mobile rig
list.where: at the customer's home or venue
list.before: a card saved for the $40 fee
list.after: the saved card is charged at DONE
list.note: the place's own permission and quiet hours are the customer's word; the engineer checks the room's power and space first

list.name: Mix check at the customer's home (flow B)
list.length: 1 hour, a listen-through with the engineer

list.name: Multi-visit location shoot (flow B)
list.price: $2,400 estimate (example): a $600 deposit now and the $1,800 rest on the bill after the last visit
list.where: at the customer's home or venue
list.after: the $1,800 rest on the bill after the last visit
list.note: the estimate is sent first and the customer says yes before the deposit

pf.services.capacity: one engineer per session; a room shows a time only when the room and the engineer are both free
pf.services.online: mixing feedback may be by shared file link; room time never
pf.services.outOfScope: renting a room by the hour with no engineer or staff is renting a space for a time, which Rosie doesn't book (Jay, Oct 24); sessions are booked with an engineer

beforeTimes: new or returning, and the kind of session: tracking, mixing, mastering, or an album block
how many songs and about how long
how many people play (a band) and the instruments
for flow B: the place, and whether there is power and room for the rig
afterTime: the file format the artist wants at the end, and any reference tracks
whether the artist needs drums, amps or a keyboard from the studio
securePage: the artist's date of birth (a minor needs a parent's OK)
each performer's own recording release, read and signed
hearing and health answers the engineer should know (stay on the secure page, never in a text)
for flow B: the address and the place's own rules on noise and hours
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian books and signs for anyone under 18, and stays on site

stop.words: fire or smoke from the gear or the room right now, or someone burned, shocked or hurt by the equipment
stop.say: Call 911 now. Get everyone out of the room. Rosie can help you book later.

goOn.words: a hearing problem, a pacemaker or a health condition near the gear
goOn.what: the booking goes on; the answer stays on the secure page, and the engineer reads it before the session; Rosie gives no medical advice

pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Session agreement
steps.when: signed on the secure page while booking, before the session
steps.who: the booker, for the studio's terms
steps.result: signed: it books; not signed in 10 minutes: nothing is booked

steps.name: Recording release
steps.when: on the secure page while booking
steps.who: every performer recorded; a parent signs for anyone under 18
steps.result: signed: it books; not signed: that person isn't recorded

pf.first_steps.prep: bring the songs in the file format you agreed, the lyrics, reference tracks, headphones, and any instruments you own; the studio supplies what its listing says

pf.visit.checkIn: at the studio: the check-in code at the front desk; for flow B: the code at the door of the place
pf.visit.beforeWork: the engineer checks the room and the gear are safe and sets levels before the first take; no session starts if the gear or the power is unsafe
pf.visit.changes: a session that runs past its block needs the artist's yes before anything more is booked; a gear fault gives a new time or a free cancel
pf.visit.done: the check-in code, or the engineer's DONE; the final files are sent to the booker
pf.visit.record: the session log (date, room, hours, what was recorded) kept with the booking
pf.visit.children: a parent or guardian stays at the studio or on site for anyone under 18; a minor is never left alone in the room

pf.money.before: tracking and album blocks are paid in full or with a deposit when booking; mixing and mastering save a card for the fee; a location shoot's deposit is taken when the estimate is said yes to
pf.money.after: a session is charged at DONE on the saved card, or paid at the front desk; an album block's rest at the last session; a location shoot's rest on the bill after the last visit
pf.money.caps: deposit cap: from the state form; prepaid money kept apart where the state's rules require it
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel until 24 hours before (the owner's setting); a studio closure or gear fault is always free
pf.money.fees: late cancel or no-show: $40, only with the owner's OK, and never more than what was paid now; never for weather, a gear fault, or an artist who says before the session that they're ill
pf.money.refunds: a session the studio cancels is never charged; an unused album block is refunded under its terms
pf.money.tax: where the state's rules tax recording services
pf.money.fee2: Rosfield's $2 applies: one $2 per confirmed booking; an album block counts once
pf.money.goods: strings, cables, drumsticks and media are the studio's own sale at the desk, outside Rosie

pf.messages.never: health and hearing answers, minors' details, and performer releases never go in a text: only the secure page
pf.messages.staffTexts: texts to engineers name the artist and the session only
pf.messages.minors: a minor's booking texts go to the parent or guardian

pf.staff.licenses: no engineer license is checked (D96); each engineer's certificate, if shown, is the engineer's own word
pf.staff.skills: tracking, mixing, mastering, live recording, location recording, and vocal and drum sessions
pf.staff.supervision: a junior engineer works only with a senior engineer in the building
pf.staff.oks: the owner OKs each longer session, every fee and every refund; the engineer reads health and hearing answers
pf.staff.standIn: another engineer with the same skill may take a session, offered to the artist first, never assumed
pf.staff.dutyLimits: an engineer works no more than 10 hours in a day (the studio's own rule)
pf.staff.away: only engineers the owner clears go to homes or venues

pf.rules.scope: engineers don't give medical or hearing advice; a hearing problem is the artist's doctor's call
pf.rules.noise: loud sessions follow the building's and the place's quiet hours (the owner's rule and the place's own rules)
pf.rules.contracts: a session or album contract over an amount, where the state's rules require one
pf.rules.minors: a minor's recording needs a parent's signed release and a parent on site
pf.rules.records: session logs and releases kept for 7 years, or longer where the state asks

pf.edges.weather: a location session in bad weather: a new time or a free cancel, with no fee
pf.edges.late: a late artist: the session is shorter inside the block
pf.edges.overrun: a session that runs over: a new block only with the artist's yes
pf.edges.gear: a gear fault: another room or a free cancel, with no fee
pf.edges.standIn: an engineer out: another engineer with the skill, offered first, or a move
pf.edges.noShow: a no-show: the fee only with the owner's OK
pf.edges.minor: a minor: a parent books, signs and stays on site
pf.edges.hurt: someone is hurt by the gear: the engineer follows the studio's steps, calls 911 if it's serious, and tells the owner at once
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way
